title: Array of Doubled Pairs
description: Check if array can be reordered such that arr[2*i+1] = 2 * arr[2*i].
pseudocode:
1. count frequencies of all elements
2. sort elements by absolute value
3. for each num in sorted array:
4. if count[num] == 0, continue
5. target = num < 0 ? num / 2 : num * 2
6. if count[target] > 0, decrement both counts
7. else return false
8. return true

steps.note: Target 2 not found in map, returning false.
